review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen PRD and inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, exact writable owner paths, task separation, verification dependency, readiness, and evidence stages agree with the original specification. The implementation owns both the option type and runtime behavior; the existing test file supports runtime regressions and compile-time assertions through tsconfig.spec.json. Build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated, so they are not separately maintained edit owners. The designated implementer and verifier have distinct identities, eligible memberships, available slots, and active trusted claims supporting the bounded TypeScript, asynchronous callback, contract, failure-handling, and testing work; verifier-specific testing.verification is present. This request does not inherently require shared data or persistent state changes, so additional data.change or domain.state claims need not be inferred from broad capability lists. The selected verifier may serve as the independent read-only planning reviewer under the supplied policy, subject to planning-author independence. No material unresolved DEC-001 or B/C scenario is supplied in this case, and no human decision is inferred. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and original/saved PRD normalization. Historical project reuse and retained operations do not constitute candidate evidence. Approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and frozen evidence, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, or new human attestation, and does not authorize task dispatch.
